title: Micah Parsons vows to come back with 'anger', says it's 'very realistic' he returns from torn ACL to face Cowboys in Week 6

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Micah Parsons vows to come back with 'anger', says it's 'very realistic' he returns from torn ACL to face Cowboys in Week 6
sources.description: Parsons isn't yet sure when he'll return from a torn ACL that cut his first season with the Green Bay Packers short. But when he does, he has a warning for opposing offenses.
